privacy.intro: MyCar.ge respects your privacy. This document explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.collectText: During registration we collect your first name, last name, email, and optionally a profile photo. When adding a listing, we store your contact phone number and information about the car.
privacy.useText: We use your data to create accounts, authenticate users, publish listings, and enable communication between users.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Contact information you include in a listing is visible to other users so they can reach you.

faq.pageIntro: Answers to the most common questions about MyCar.ge.
faq.q1: How do I add a listing?
faq.a1: Register or log in to your account, then click "Add a car" and fill in the required information step by step.
faq.a2: Yes, adding a listing on MyCar.ge is completely free.
faq.q3: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a3: Each listing shows the seller's contact phone number, which you can use to reach them directly.
faq.a4: Yes, from your profile, under "My listings", you can edit or delete any listing.
faq.q5: What happens if I can't verify my account?
faq.a5: A verification code is sent to your email right after registration. If you can't find it, check your spam folder or try registering again.
faq.q6: How do I change my settings?
faq.a6: On your profile page, under "Settings", you can update your first name, last name, and profile photo.
